description: This PHP class, TemplateText, defines a template for text fields within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM framework. It extends the TemplateField class and provides methods for rendering edit, search, and detail views of a text field, as well as support for help text and default values.

classes.name: TemplateText
classes.description: A PHP class that extends TemplateField to implement text field behavior in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM, including methods for getting edit, search, and detail view representations.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Generates template variables for editing the text field, including help text and current or default value.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Returns the current search request value for the field from the HTTP request, if available.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns the current value of the field for display in detail views.
